scenicChapters.title: Czech Bohemian Paradise Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 20 km this is Czech Bohemian Paradise Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-pruhonice-park-pohlberg-mining-la.story: 357 km from Průhonice to Průhonice, about 6 h 09 of riding. On the way it passes Historic Centre of Prague, Žatec and the Landscape of Saaz Hops, Mědník Hill Mining Landscape and Pöhlberg Mining Landscape. It crosses from Czechia into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-gostilitskoe-highway-the-blocade-.story: A 284 km round trip from Petrodvorets - roughly 4 h 54 in the saddle. The stops in between: Dudergof, Ligovsky prospect, The Park «Mariental» and The Blocade Ring. The line favours views over speed.
